extracted.name: Namakpare
instruction_lines: Mix all-purpose flour,mixed herbs,salt and carrom seeds.heat 2 tspoon of oil and pour it on flour.mix well and Knead a dough
Rest for 30 minutes.roll out thin chapati.cut it in pieces.heat oil in kadai add namakpare to oil. Fry till golden brown.
Serve with hot tea or it's a best option for tiffin.
